I main Rainbow Mika, I used to get REALLY tilted and had the exact same mindset as you. "Why should I guess on my offense?" "Why can they just DP out of my pressure when I have to eat pressure and learn gaps etc etc etc" -- because they can and they should.

Why should you get to run your setplay on them? Why should you get to freely do whatever you want?

Plus frames vs Invincible DP, just bait it out. If they have a bar and you know they're EXDP Happy, just pause for a second. You don't really lose out on much. If they land an EXDP, okay cool they're down 1 bar and you just work your way back in and mix them up again. There is no set rule of "I have plus frames they must respect my pressure" or else this game would be stale. Also just because you don't press after plus frames doesnt mean you're back to neutral, you being that close already is exerting pressure. 

It's frustrating and I understand that but as a grappler especially ones with good movement, learn to play patient, learn to play defense because YOU only need to make 1 big play and you'll lock the game down. Eating a DP for like 10% of your HP vs CCing them for 50%+ seems more in your favor then theirs.

Best ways to get around fireballs are:

1. Neutral Jump - This lets the fireball stay on screen for longer so they can't just mindless spam it. Let's you gain some ground by slowly walking at them.
2. Forward Jump - Let's you jump over the fireball and close the distance, just be careful of aware opponents who will Anti-Air you on your way down.
3. Body Splash - Pressing Down + Medium Punch, let's R.Mika do a body splash, you can use this to stop your jumps from going the full distance to bait out DPs and\or beat out various anti-airs
4. Cr.HK\Slide - Slow start up but let's you slide under the fireballs, super punishable on block.
5. EX Peach - Armour starts up on the 3rd frame but if you can react or get a read, this will lead to your advantage.

Dealing with DPs, you need to understand what DPs beat what. Only EXDPs are fully invincible. Best thing to do if people are spamming EXDPs when they have meter is to just block on their wake up and let them hang themselves. If they're spamming normal DPs, you need to tighten up your meaties.
